cohort: Neonates admitted into the Special Care Baby Unit of Babcock University Teaching Hospital, Ilishan-Remo, Nigeria, over five years between January 2014 and December 2018.
finding: Outborn status and preterm delivery were significantly associated with neonatal mortality, while perinatal asphyxia and prematurity were the leading causes of death among the hospitalized neonates.
birth_weight: 27.8% of babies were low birth weight.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth was 37 weeks; 70.2% were delivered at term.
